name: Member borrows a copy of a title
actor: Library member (at the desk or in the web app)
goal: Walk away with a physical copy and a loan that has a due date
hops: catalog/views.py:BookViewSet.borrow — reads the member id and asks for a free copy
catalog/services/catalog_service.py:CatalogService.first_available_copy — picks the copy to hand over
lending/services/loan_service.py:LoanService.checkout — the central rule of the flow
lending/domain/policies.py:is_within_loan_limit — refuses a member who is at their tier limit
lending/domain/policies.py:due_date_for — sets the due date from the member tier
catalog/models.py:Copy.mark_lent — takes the copy off the shelf
lending/models.py:Loan — stores the open loan
failure_paths: no copy on the shelf -> 409 from the view, before any lending code runs
rules: LP-01 max-three-open-loans (basic tier; scholar and staff get more)
notes: The only flow that starts in the catalog app and ends inside lending; the seam is the LoanService call in the view.

name: Member reserves a title that is fully lent out
goal: Hold a place in the queue for the next copy of a title to come back
hops: lending/handlers/place_reservation.py:PlaceReservationHandler.handle — owns the reservation decision
lending/services/loan_service.py:LoanService.get_member — loads the member the request refers to
catalog/services/catalog_service.py:CatalogService.count_available_copies — refuses while a copy is free
lending/handlers/place_reservation.py:PlaceReservationHandler.can_place — checks the queue allowance
lending/domain/policies.py:is_within_reservation_limit — enforces the tier reservation limit
lending/domain/policies.py:reservation_expiry — decides how long the claim holds
lending/models.py:Reservation — stores the queued claim
failure_paths: a copy is still on the shelf -> lending/handlers/place_reservation.py:CopyStillAvailable
notes: Declared as a command entry point on purpose: the handler is callable without any route, and the HTTP wrapper (BookViewSet.reserve) is only one of its callers.

name: Desk clerk takes a copy back and settles the fine
goal: Close the loan, charge whatever is owed and release the copy to the next member in line
hops: lending/handlers/return_book.py:ReturnBookHandler.handle — closes the loan and looks at the queue
lending/domain/policies.py:days_overdue — measures how late the return is
lending/domain/policies.py:calculate_fine — turns late days into cents after the grace period
lending/services/loan_service.py:LoanService.return_copy — settles the loan record
catalog/models.py:Copy.mark_returned — puts the copy back on the shelf
lending/models.py:Loan.close — records the return date and the fine
lending/handlers/return_book.py:ReturnBookHandler.next_in_queue — finds who was waiting
lending/tasks/notify_overdue.py:deliver_notice — tells that member a copy is waiting
async_legs: the notice to the next member is delivered outside the return transaction in a real deployment
failure_paths: nobody is waiting -> the reservation leg is skipped and the summary reports reservation_fulfilled false
notes: Deliberately has no entry_points key: the pipeline falls back to the first resolved hop, so this use-case still gets one entry point of kind other.

name: Nightly job chases members with overdue loans
goal: Send every member holding an overdue copy the notice with the fine accrued so far
hops: lending/services/overdue_service.py:OverdueService.notify_all — drives the sweep
lending/services/overdue_service.py:OverdueService.find_overdue — selects the open loans past their due date
lending/tasks/notify_overdue.py:notify_batch — walks the batch and counts the notices
lending/domain/policies.py:days_overdue — measures how late each loan is
lending/tasks/notify_overdue.py:build_notice — renders the payload with the formatted fine
lending/tasks/notify_overdue.py:deliver_notice — hands the notice to the delivery channel
async_legs: lending/tasks/notify_overdue.py:notify_all_open_loans is the same sweep without a preselected batch
failure_paths: a loan still inside the grace period gets a notice with a zero fine
notes: Nothing in the fixture schedules this; the cron kind records the intent, not an observed trigger.

name: Reader browses titles and sees live availability
goal: Find a title and know whether a copy can be picked up right now
hops: catalog/views.py:BookViewSet.list — reads the optional search parameter
catalog/services/catalog_service.py:CatalogService.list_books — builds the query in one place
catalog/serializers.py:BookSerializer.get_available_copies — asks the service instead of the ORM
catalog/services/catalog_service.py:CatalogService.count_available_copies — counts what is lendable
catalog/models.py:Book.available_copies — filters the copies that are on the shelf
notes: No test covers this read path in the fixture; the empty tests list is the honest answer rather than a guess.

name: Desk clerk starts a loan and gets one of three outcomes
goal: Know, at the desk, whether the loan opened or which rule refused it
hops: catalog/views.py:BookViewSet.borrow — hands the free copy and the member id to lending
lending/services/loan_service.py:LoanService.checkout — seam: crosses from catalog into lending; the one place that decides
lending/services/loan_service.py:MemberSuspended — branch: the card is suspended; nothing is written
lending/services/loan_service.py:LoanLimitReached — branch: the member is at the tier loan limit; nothing is written
lending/models.py:Loan — branch: allowed; the copy is marked lent and the loan is opened
rules: LP-01 max-three-open-loans (basic tier; scholar and staff get more)
notes: The same request as 'Member borrows a copy of a title', told from the desk and ending at the fork: checkout chooses one of three outcomes, so the three are branch: siblings of one level (3a, 3b, 3c). The two refusals terminate; with no hop after the fan the Flow draws no reconvergence. The siblings that live in the selector's own file appear in the Flow scene, not on the map overlay (data contract 5.1).
